title: Gotrade Daily: Nvidia Without Huang, PPI Tonight
summary: Nvidia trades a second session without Jensen Huang. Tonight: US producer prices, plus Cisco and Applied Materials after their quarterly results.
body_markdown:
Senate Banking Committee Chairman Tim Scott also asked Huang and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to testify,[according to Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-senate-banking-committee-chair-calls-on-jensen-huang-lutnick-to-testify-5023793) .


### US producer prices


The October Producer Price Index is due at 8:30 a.m. ET,[according to the BLS schedule](https://www.bls.gov/schedule/2026/11_sched_list.htm) . Economists polled by Dow Jones expect PPI to rise 0.4% from September and 6.6% from a year earlier, according to CNBC.


The data follows a hotter-than-expected October consumer price report. Traders fully price a quarter-point Fed rate hike next month,[according to Bloomberg](https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/us-stock-futures-fall-as-nvidia-turmoil-deepens:-markets-wrap/92367440) .


### Cisco and Applied Materials after earnings


**Cisco ([CSCO](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/csco/) )** reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $18.5 billion, up 24%, and non-GAAP EPS of $1.40,[according to its release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/858877/000085887726000170/exhibit991pressrelease-q1f.htm) . Both beat LSEG estimates of $18.1 billion and $1.33,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/cisco-csco-q1-2027-earnings.html) . Cisco raised its full-year revenue outlook to $74.8 billion to $75.8 billion.


**Applied Materials ([AMAT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/amat/) )** reported record fourth-quarter revenue of $10.41 billion, up 53%,[according to its release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6951/000162828026073360/exhibit991q42026earningsre.htm) . It forecast next-quarter revenue of about $11.10 billion, above the LSEG consensus of $10.89 billion,[according to Reuters](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/applied-materials-forecasts-quarterly-revenue-above-estimates-on-strong-ai-chip-demand-5023205) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


Dow futures rose 0.3%, S&P 500 futures 0.4% and Nasdaq 100 futures 0.6% on Thursday evening in New York, according to CNBC.


After hours on Thursday, Modine Manufacturing jumped more than 29% after Bloomberg reported that Samsung is in talks to buy the data center cooling company, according to CNBC.


## Conclusion


Tonight the market tests whether pressure on Nvidia continues without Huang, while the PPI data shapes expectations for the Fed's next move. Cisco and Applied Materials results give a read on demand for networking gear and chip equipment.


US markets open at 9:30 a.m. ET, an hour after the PPI data.
